answer_1.quote: For generative tasks such as summarization or machine translation, parsing scripts are usually not required … the full response generated by LLMs are compared against the gold reference. In this regard, ROUGE and BLEU … are widely used.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses, code snippets, summaries

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation for LLMs can be divided into the following: Language Modeling – Perplexity … Discriminative Tasks – metrics such as Exact Match, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1 … Generative Tasks – ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore, BARTScore, AlignScore.

answer_3.quote: Since human evaluation is time‑consuming, the utilization of LLMs as evaluators to assess other LLMs has become a popular evaluation approach … the recently proposed Prometheus‑2 model is an open‑source variant … used as a judge.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is required to ensure qualitative assessments of LLM responses (e.g., measuring clarity, coherence, factuality) … Human evaluation based on the Elo‑based rating system has gained a lot of attention.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate generated outputs on criteria such as clarity, coherence, factuality, and helpfulness using human raters or crowdsourced annotators.
